learning_objective: 🎯 Let us imagine a fun and magical world where our favourite toys come alive and talk!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When the moon comes up and everyone goes to sleep, something magical happens. The toys wake up and start to play!
The teddy bear talks to the toy train, and the dolls have a tiny tea party. They whisper sweet stories to each other.
Our toys love us very much. We must always pack them away neatly in their toy box after playing.

fun_activity.title: 🗣️ Toy Interview
fun_activity.instructions: Pick up your favourite toy. Pretend it can talk and ask it three questions! What is your name? What do you like to eat?

quick_recap: ⭐ In our story, toys come alive and play with each other at night.
⭐ Toys have their own magical secret world.
⭐ We must always keep our toys safe and clean.
